claim_scores.justification: The replication used the exact Lax-Liu #6 setup and produced the expected swirling contact structure, matching the paper's qualitative result.
Uniform FV runs show L1 convergence rates (0.82, 1.26) within the paper's reported range (0.64-1.18), confirming the core numerical trend.
Mesh compression ordering (MR < AMR) was not reproduced; simplified MR flags more cells than AMR at canonical thresholds, likely due to indicator and scale differences.
No distinct MR vs AMR FV schemes were implemented, so relative convergence rates were not tested.
Adaptive mesh refinement and time-stepping were not implemented, so CPU compression trends were not tested.
Only one implementation was used; absolute runtime comparison between MR and AMR codes is not applicable.

parsed.overall_reasoning: Core numerical claims (problem correctness and uniform convergence) are replicated, but structural claims about adaptivity and mesh compression were not reproduced or not tested. The replication is a spot-check of the base FV scheme, not a full test of adaptivity or code comparison.
parsed.one_line_summary: Uniform FV convergence and problem correctness replicated; adaptivity and mesh compression claims not reproduced or tested.
